selected.title: Dataset of Stagnant Water and Wet Surface
selected.notes: 1976 pares anotados em YOLO; a classe source 0 (water) e mapeada para agua_acumulada. Raw data e wet surface isolada sao excluidos.

selected.title: CLICK Trash Dataset v2
selected.notes: 1126 fotografias reais; usa anotacoes YOLO single-class revisadas. O downloader usa HTTP Range e nao transfere o ZIP completo.
excluded: 13-class label set; single-class reviewed labels are used

selected.title: iRodent: rodents in the wild
selected.notes: Metadados declaram 443 imagens, mas os JSONs COCO do arquivo indexam 447 (357 train + 90 test). O registro Zenodo declara Apache-2.0, mas as imagens-fonte sao CC BY-NC; uso comercial requer revisao.
excluded: keypoints and masks are not training targets in this detector
